name.ja: HG 1/48 レギンレイヴ（シン搭乗機）

description.ja: 『86 ーエイティシックスー』より、主人公達が搭乗する新たな機体「レギンレイヴ」がHGで登場！
description.en: From "86 -Eighty Six ", a new aircraft " Reginrave" piloted by the main characters is now available in HG!

description.ja: 初回生産限定には原作イラスト担当“しらび氏”のイラストを使用したペーパーブックカバーが同梱。
description.en: The first limited edition will include a paper book cover featuring an illustration by Mr. Shirabi, who is in charge of the original illustration.

description.ja: ■ジャガーノート（別売り）に比べて胴体や脚部の装甲が強化され、ボリュームアップしたレギンレイヴの機体を再現。
description.en: • Compared to the Juggernaut (sold separately), the armor on the torso and legs has been strengthened, and the body of the Reginrave has been increased in volume.

description.ja: ■胴体の脚付け根、脚部の関節、脚部装甲に複数の可動軸を設けることで、激しいアクションが再現可能。
description.en: • By providing multiple movable axes for the torso's groin, leg joints, and leg armor, intense actions can be reproduced.

description.ja: ■背部の軸可動と引き出し構造により、背中の武装を多方向に動かすことができる。背部の各武装は別機体へも取り付け可能。
description.en: • The armament on the back can be moved in multiple directions due to the pivot movement and drawer structure on the back. Each weapon on the back can be attached to another aircraft.

description.ja: ■脚部先端のパイルドライバも引き出し可動で再現。
description.en: • The pile driver at the end of the leg can also be pulled out and reproduced.

description.ja: ■ワイヤーアンカーはリード線を使用し戦闘シーンを演出。ワイヤーアンカーの先端パーツは２種類付属。
description.en: • Wire anchor uses lead wire to create a battle scene. Two types of wire anchor tip parts are included.

description.ja: ■キャノピーには開閉ギミックを搭載。
description.en: • The canopy is equipped with an opening and closing gimmick.

description.ja: ■コックピットの細かなディテールを再現。また、コックピットへ取り付け可能なフィギュア(シン)が付属。
description.en: • Reproduce the fine details of the cockpit. Also included is a figure (shin) that can be attached to the cockpit.

description.ja: ■ジャガーノートの特徴を参考に「滑腔砲」を装備。
description.en: • Equipped with a "smoothbore cannon" based on the characteristics of the Juggernaut.

description.ja: ■サブアームには「高周波ブレード」が付属。
description.en: • The sub-arm comes with a "high frequency blade".
